integrity: The all-parameter statement has a direct combinatorial proof from the defining partial-sum formula. The bundled verifier independently reconstructs representative dimensions and checks the facet identity and face-vector formula; finite checks are supporting evidence rather than the basis of the proof.
limitations: Only the repeated-length family with k-1 unit entries and one entry 2 is classified.
No classification is claimed for arbitrary nongeneric or all-distinct nongeneric generalized Tonnetze.
title: A sphere family from repeated-length generalized Tonnetze
